title: TSMC 3Q26 Earnings Conference Presentation Materials & Press Release
gist: TSMC reported 3Q26 revenue of NT$1,494.24B (US$46.72B), up 50.9% YoY in NT dollars, with a 66.4% gross margin and 2nm already 8% of wafer revenue. It guided 4Q26 revenue to US$52.3-54.3B on a steep 2nm ramp.

insights.claim: TSMC's third-quarter 2026 consolidated revenue was NT$1,494.24 billion (US$46.72 billion), up 50.9% year over year and 17.6% quarter over quarter in NT dollars.
insights.speaker: Daniel Nenni
insights.so_what: Sets the revenue base against which the 4Q26 guide and the leading-edge ramp should be judged.

insights.claim: TSMC's 3Q26 net income rose 68.7% year over year to NT$763.06 billion, with diluted EPS of NT$29.43 (US$4.60 per ADR unit), so profit is growing faster than the 50.9% revenue growth.
insights.speaker: Daniel Nenni
insights.so_what: Operating leverage is outpacing top-line growth; watch EPS revisions for TSM ADRs.

insights.claim: TSMC posted a 66.4% gross margin, 58.7% operating margin and 51.1% net profit margin in 3Q26, extremely high for a foundry.
insights.speaker: Daniel Nenni
insights.so_what: Margins this high indicate strong pricing power at the leading edge; a margin slip would be an early warning signal.
insights.locator: Gross margin for the quarter was 66.4%

insights.claim: In US dollar terms TSMC's 3Q26 revenue grew 41.2% year over year and 16.2% quarter over quarter, slower than the NT dollar growth rates of 50.9% and 17.6%.
insights.speaker: Daniel Nenni
insights.so_what: The gap between NT dollar and US dollar growth shows currency effects; compare USD figures when benchmarking against peers.
insights.locator: In US dollars, third quarter revenue was $46.72 billion

insights.claim: In 3Q26, TSMC's 2-nanometer shipments were 8% of wafer revenue, 3nm 33%, 5nm 28% and 7nm 10%.
insights.speaker: Daniel Nenni
insights.so_what: 2nm contributes meaningful revenue in its first quarters, supporting demand for leading-edge capacity and equipment.
insights.locator: In the third quarter, shipments of 2-nanometer

insights.claim: Advanced technologies (7nm and more advanced) made up 79% of TSMC's 3Q26 wafer revenue, so the business is concentrated in leading-edge nodes.
insights.speaker: Daniel Nenni
insights.so_what: Revenue depends heavily on leading-edge demand, which ties TSMC results to AI and high-end customers' spending.
insights.locator: Advanced technologies, defined as 7-nanometer and more advanced

insights.claim: TSMC guides 4Q26 revenue to US$52.3-54.3 billion, implying roughly 12-16% sequential growth from the US$46.72 billion in 3Q26.
insights.speaker: Daniel Nenni
insights.so_what: Another double-digit sequential increase points to continued strength in the semiconductor and AI hardware supply chain.
insights.locator: Revenue is expected to be between US$52.3 billion and US$54.3 billion

insights.claim: TSMC expects 4Q26 gross margin of 65-67% and operating margin of 56.5-58.5%, assuming 31.8 NT dollars per US dollar, so margins are guided roughly flat to slightly down from 3Q26.
insights.speaker: Daniel Nenni
insights.so_what: The guided margin range brackets the 66.4% gross margin just reported; the ramp-up cost of 2nm may cap further expansion.
insights.locator: Gross profit margin is expected to be between 65% and 67%

insights.claim: TSMC's CFO Wendell Huang attributes 4Q26 expectations to continued strong demand for leading-edge processes, including a steep ramp-up of 2-nanometer technology.
insights.speaker: Daniel Nenni
insights.so_what: Management points to 2nm as the next growth driver; track customer adoption and ramp pace for read-through to suppliers.
insights.quote: we expect our business to be supported by continued strong demand for our leading-edge process technologies, including the steep ramp-up of our 2-nanometer technology.
insights.locator: Our business in the third quarter was supported by strong demand
